We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly the sample is implicit? Maybe we need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to see methyl signals. But we don't know the molecule's SMILES. No input given. Perhaps the system expects we ask for NMR? But we have no SMILES. The tools carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra don't require parameters. They operate on "sample at hand". So there is a sample loaded. We can get proton NMR to see methyl peaks (singlet around 0.9 ppm). But we need count of methyl groups, not number of methyl protons. Methyl groups each have 3 protons. So count peaks integrated? The tool returns spectra as string, maybe includes integration. Could parse.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
